messages:
Priya: dropping a screenshot of the suppression scheduler draft. wanting feedback on recurrence UI (daily/weekdays/custom), timezone label, and the preview table. https://figma.com/file/suppression-scheduler :mag:
Liam: high-level: the recurrence dropdown is fine but the custom editor feels heavy. Can we inline quick presets (e.g., Mon-Fri 10pm-6am) and keep an "advanced" modal for complex rules?
Noah: copy: users search for 'snooze' or 'quiet' as well. Recommend 'Suppress notifications (snooze)' as the header and then a tooltip that differentiates: "Suppress = don't send notifications; Quiet = still log incidents" if we need both.
Elena: on the preview table, I want a clear column for "Effective recipients" — right now the preview only shows channels and times. It should show primary vs. oncall escalation vs. webhooks.
Priya: agree. thinking of a compact matrix: rows = channels, columns = active / suppressed / fallback. Hover shows escalation order.
Liam: mobile note: the table needs a stacked card view on narrow screens. Also make the timezone visible; people in multi-region companies often miss that the schedule is in account timezone. Add a small chevron that opens a timezone selector.
Noah: QA edge-case: daylight savings transitions will bite us. For example a 2am-3am window on DST day might be truncated. Can we indicate the rule uses "local time (with DST)" and include a test harness?
qa-bot: checklist: 1) test DST boundary behavior, 2) test crossing-midnight windows (e.g., 22:00-06:00), 3) timezone override per-project, 4) preview accuracy when channel order changes.
Elena: accessibility: table headers must be real <th>s and the matrix should support screenreader flattening. When users change recurrence, announce a summary: "Suppression active weekdays 22:00 to 06:00 local time" in an aria-live region. Also keyboard trap avoidance in the timezone modal.
Priya: microcopy proposal for the preview row: "#team-oncall — Suppressed (during rule) — Next: #backup-oncall". Short and scannable.
Liam: microcopy tweak: shorten to "Suppressed  Next: #backup-oncall"? maybe too terse. Keep "Suppressed (during rule)" as clearer.
Noah: backend note: if a channel is removed but a suppression references it, show: "Channel removed  Alerts follow escalation" and include a link to edit escalation. Users get anxious seeing removed channels silently affect behavior.
Priya: add a "simulate" control in preview that runs a few examples across a week and shows who would receive notifications for a sample alert. Example output:
```
Mon 2026-03-23 23:15 UTC -> suppressed: true -> recipient: #backup-oncall
Tue 2026-03-24 02:45 UTC -> suppressed: false -> recipient: #team-oncall
```
Elena: also include an exportable sample payload for webhook owners so integrators can confirm their receiver logic. Keep it collapsed by default.
ux-bot: UX checklist: 1) presets + advanced modal, 2) visible timezone with selector, 3) stacked mobile cards, 4) simulate button, 5) inline help microcopy, 6) collapsed sample payload.
deploy-bot: visual mock pushed to staging at https://staging.console.redwood/alerting/suppress-scheduler (visual only).
Priya: next steps: I'll update the Figma with presets + DST hint, add simulate output and sample payload, and schedule a short usability session. tagging Noah and Elena for QA/a11y review tomorrow. :calendar:
